label: estimated from imagery by the Wire Frame Scanner
note: One entry per public register farm. 'rows' names a lon/lat row file baked by the GPU lab: {rows: [[[lon,lat],[lon,lat]], ...], metres_per_pixel, sample_step_px, ...}. Register points are the public register's own point, not a survey. Rule R5-9: rows come from LiDAR only where every DSM and DTM survey year under the farm is later than its build year; otherwise the LiDAR is pre-construction ground and rows come from imagery, labelled estimated.

point.source: DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 (July 2026 edition), point basis: retained Pipeline index; register coordinates, not a survey

site_area_m2.source: DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 site area field, as declared in the register

sample_step_px.source: GPU lab detect.py: runs sampled every 3 px across the row direction

build_year.source: DESNZ REPD operational date (year), as carried in the register record

lidar_survey_years.source: Environment Agency survey index for the 5 km tile under the farm, products lidar_composite_first_return_dsm and lidar_composite_dtm (read 27 September 2026)

imagery.source: Esri World Imagery metadata identify at the register point, release Raster Basemaps 2026.R03 (read 27 September 2026); the bake's tiles are assumed to be this capture
